name: Espresso Martini
flavor_notes: A classic chilled coffee cocktail, combining bold espresso with vodka and vanilla syrup, garnished with a strawberry and cacao nibs.
barista_note: Pour espresso directly over ice to preserve the temperature boundary and prevent watery dilution.

preparations.roast_note: Bold, roasty profile with low acidity to punch through sweet syrups and cream.
preparations.tested_with: Counter Culture Forty-Six or Equator Mocha Java

ingredients.notes: A little stronger than the original: Cometeer capsules can't be split. For less caffeine, use Half Caff (~90 mg) or Decaf capsules; same flavor.

steps: ## Phase 1: Flavor Base & Extraction
In your serving glass, combine Vodka, Vanilla-Flavored or Plain and 3 tsp Vanilla Syrup.

Melt the Cometeer capsule (about 5 minutes submerged in hot water, or overnight in the fridge). Pour it directly over the syrups and spices; stir or whisk with a handheld frother until completely dissolved.
## Phase 2: Ice & Milk Pour
Fill the glass with plenty of ice cubes.
Pour cold milk over the ice; stir gently to combine and watch the layers swirl.
## Phase 3: Crown & Garnish
Finish with a dusting of Strawberry.

steps: Brew the Nespresso Decaffeinato Intenso capsule.
Combine the brewed espresso, vodka, and vanilla syrup in a cocktail shaker.
Fill the shaker with ice, cover, and shake vigorously until well chilled.
Strain the mixture into a martini glass.
If using, slice a whole strawberry three-quarters of the way through from the bottom and place it on the glass rim.
If using, top with a few cacao nibs.

steps: ## Phase 1: Flavor Base & Extraction
In your serving glass, combine Vodka, Vanilla-Flavored or Plain and 3 tsp Vanilla Syrup.
Dissolve 1 tsp instant espresso in 1 oz (30 ml) hot water directly over the syrups and spices; stir until completely dissolved.
## Phase 2: Ice & Milk Pour
Fill the glass with plenty of ice cubes.
Pour cold milk over the ice; stir gently to combine and watch the layers swirl.
## Phase 3: Crown & Garnish
Finish with a dusting of Strawberry.
